edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the owner in the Owned constructor, establishing the privileged role.
transferOwnership is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) via onlyOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before replacing owner.
transfernewun can only be invoked by the owner-controlling msg.sender.
msg.sender indexes the debited balance in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed into the external receiveApproval callback and re-enters token accounting.
clearCNDAO assigns msg.sender to payable _owner and pays it the whole balance.
owner state variable backs the onlyOwner gate of transferOwnership.
owner state variable backs the onlyOwner gate of transfernewun.
owner state variable backs the onlyOwner gate of clearCNDAO.
newOwner state variable is the authorization condition of acceptOwnership.
require(to != newun) in transfer branches on the newun state variable.
transferFrom branches on newun == address(0) and to != newun.
Owned constructor writes owner.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).

totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads newun for the blocked-recipient check.
transfer credits and debits the balances mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom may write newun = to when newun is unset.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
transfer performs balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) arithmetic on unchecked parameterized amount.
transfer performs balances[to].add(tokens) arithmetic that can overflow without SafeMath guarantees.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance.
transferFrom decrements balances[from] by the caller-supplied tokens amount.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance by the caller-supplied tokens amount.
transferFrom increments balances[to] by the caller-supplied tokens amount.
totalSupply uses SafeMath.sub for the burned-balance subtraction.
totalSupply computes _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]) which can underflow.
clearCNDAO performs an ETH value transfer of address(this).balance to msg.sender.
clearCNDAO assigns the payable recipient local _owner from msg.sender.

The external receiveApproval callback executes attacker code that can re-enter transfer/transferFrom as msg.sender.
